output.review_comment: The implementation has critical logic errors: (1) Open-ended tier handling incorrectly charges entire quantity at open-ended price, ignoring earlier tiers - this breaks graduated pricing semantics, (2) The +1 formula change is unexplained and risks off-by-one errors, (3) Potential TypeError if last=None reaches the graduated pricing loop. The changes appear to alter the pricing model from graduated to bulk-discount rather than fixing the actual bug. Needs substantial revision to maintain proper graduated pricing logic.
